title: Down feather
blurb: The down of birds is a layer of fine feathers found under the tougher exterior feathers. Very young birds are clad only in down.
facts: Powder down is a specialized type of down found only in a few groups of birds.
Down is a fine thermal insulator and padding, used in goods such as jackets, bedding, pillows and sleeping bags.
The discovery of feathers trapped in ancient amber suggests that some species of non-avian dinosaur likely possessed down-like feathers.
